Upstream https://github.com/yetone/magpie-releases/releases/tag/v0.1.4735

Downstream build `384001cf32837edde0250c4c8e33b73a406b4088`. Windows desktop executable and macOS DMG / update ZIP.

## Features
- Share artifacts on usemagpie.ai with a link that follows each version.

## Improvements
- Load Discover weekly rankings outside core scripts for better performance.

## Bug Fixes
- Shared pages no longer include Cloudflare's analytics beacon.

### Install

Download from [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai), or `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`. An installed magpie updates itself.

- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `magpie-darwin-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS (Intel):** `magpie-darwin-amd64.dmg`
- **Windows:** `magpie-windows-amd64.exe` (ARM: `magpie-windows-arm64.exe`)
- **Linux:** `magpie-linux-amd64` / `magpie-linux-arm64` (needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1)
- **Terminal only:** `magpie-cli-<os>-<arch>`

Thanks to ArvinChen9539, whose reports and code went into this release. Everyone who helped: [contributors](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/contributors).

## 功能
- 在 usemagpie.ai 上分享构件，并附上随每个版本更新的链接。

## 改进
- 在核心脚本之外加载 Discover 每周排名，以提高性能。

## 错误修复
- 共享页面不再包含 Cloudflare 的分析信标。

### 安装

从 [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai) 下载，或运行 `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`。已安装的 magpie 会自动更新。
